description: Cliptalk is an AI video creation service that turns prompts, scripts, links, and media into finished videos with visuals, voiceover, captions, music, and talking presenters. It also offers a set of free creator tools and templates for short-form, marketing, and story video workflows.
summary: Cliptalk exposes two developer surfaces on cliptalk.pro: an OAuth-protected REST API at `https://www.cliptalk.pro/api/v1` and an OAuth-protected Streamable HTTP MCP server at `https://www.cliptalk.pro/mcp`; both use self-onboarding OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration.
